Lily Anfang is a senior engineering student at Harvey Mudd College specializing in biomedical and electrical engineering. 
They have completed research in the Harvey Mudd CACTI Lab as well as the FAMU-FSU College of Engineering RIDER Lab.
They are currently researching in the Harvey Mudd Cell Culture Microfluidics and Tissue Engineering (CuTE) Lab.
They are interested in analog electrical design, embedded systems, and medical devices.
Their current research focusses on modulating molecular cargo in glioblastoma exosomes.
